scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF peer release state, writer-loss evidence, explicit 3D entity frame/topology contracts, and comparator admission; update the implementation plan without asserting local defects or promoting support.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary Autodesk DXF references, current LibreDWG release and documentation, ACadSharp issue/PR/release pages, ezdxf current API documentation, and the local plan
method.sourcePinning: Mutable web pages were inspected as of 2026-10-16; no peer binaries or packages were downloaded or executed. The ACadSharp release tag and PR state are identified for future pinning, not treated as runtime results.
method.evidenceRule: Peer feature matrices, issue reports, documentation, and self-round-trips select test routes only. They do not prove local behavior, normative format rules unless from Autodesk/ODA, independent semantic correctness, complete object-graph retention, or native consumer acceptance.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG current release/security and test-coverage boundaries
evidence.observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 is labeled beta and dated 2026-07-25. Its NEWS lists security fixes involving R2004 compressed-section sizing, R2007 page offsets, and 3DSOLID block-size bounds. The current format notes distinguish unhandled classes and list missing example_2018 test coverage for BODY, MESH, POLYLINE_MESH, VERTEX_MESH and multiple object families.
doesNotEstablish: that a current LibreDWG binary was built or exercised
that every listed untested type is unsupported
that LibreDWG is an independent semantic oracle for every peer route
evidence.planUse: Pin exact LibreDWG release/commit and executable for composed, route-specific comparisons. Use its security and coverage notes to choose local hostile-input and type-family controls; keep long fuzz/sanitizer campaigns at composed checkpoints rather than per slice.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp release refresh and nested ACIS writer omission
evidence.observed: Issue #1195 reports ACadSharp 3.4.9 omitting DWG-read 3DSOLID/REGION content in DXF output, including solid-only blocks. As observed on 2026-10-16, #1195 and dependent PR #1240 remained open; #1240 showed no reviews or deployment and depended on #1174. The latest listed release was v3.8.0 at commit 3a1c66b. The issue's customer drawings were not available in the report.
doesNotEstablish: the current runtime behavior of ACadSharp v3.8.0
the prevalence of ACIS omission outside the named reports
evidence.planUse: Refresh the optional peer comparator from the stale v3.6.51 note to exact v3.8.0 or later, and identify any experimental PR build separately. Preserve the existing local per-block/per-owner ACIS census and fail-closed publication gates.

evidence.observed: The current MESH entity page lists DXF R2000 as the required version while the current layout factory documentation says add_mesh requires R2007; the POLYFACE tutorial says MESH requires R2000+. The tutorial separately states that POLYFACE faces are triangles/quads, MESH permits n-gons, and converting concave n-gons to POLYFACE/3DFACE triangles may be invalid.
doesNotEstablish: runtime behavior of a pinned ezdxf release
that MESH and POLYFACE are semantically interchangeable
correctness of triangulating arbitrary concave faces
evidence.planUse: Do not derive version compatibility from the inconsistent peer pages. Use Autodesk/ODA or an exact pinned native producer for release admission; keep MESH subdivision/creases and POLYFACE face topology as separate versioned routes.

evidence.topic: Autodesk explicit 3D frame, mesh, polyface and ACIS wrapper contracts
evidence.observed: Autodesk's OCS/WCS table assigns explicit 3D entity points including 3DFACE, 3D polylines/vertices, and 3D mesh to WCS, while planar entities such as 2D SOLID/TRACE use OCS. MESH has level-0 vertex, face, edge, crease and override fields. POLYFACE is a POLYLINE child sequence with coordinate vertices and face-index records, at most four vertex indices per face; readers should tolerate noncanonical ordering. 3DSOLID stores modeler format group 70, proprietary payload fragments in ordered groups 1/3 across subclass boundaries, and an optional group-350 history-object handle.
doesNotEstablish: closed B-rep topology or exact shape semantics
evidence.planUse: Require per-route assertions for coordinate frame, topology/sequence, carrier fragment order, object handles and owner/history closure. Keep explicit polygonal geometry, inline DXF ACIS, DWG AcDs, and semantic shape outcomes separate.

implementationReadiness.activeNextSliceUnchanged: Complete the existing FIELD/FIELDLIST emitted-record identity and remapped-reference closure gate while export remains fail-closed; this research does not resolve FIELD producer semantics.
per3DSliceAcceptance: source type/handle to emitted type/handle, exact section, owner path, and explicit preserved/transformed/lost/refused disposition
separate inventories for model space, each block definition, and each paper-space layout
WCS/OCS/elevation/extrusion assertions on the relevant explicit 3D families
MESH topology/subdivision/crease controls separate from POLYFACE signed indices and 3DFACE polygon controls
ACIS payload fragments, group-350 history edge, DWG AcDs association, shape semantics, and native acceptance as separate gates
implementationReadiness.publicationPolicy: Normal complete-conversion profile refuses atomically on unsupported required records. A deliberately selected 2D projection may omit 3D only with an explicit loss inventory before publication.
implementationReadiness.peerCadence: No peer installation/run during leaf slices. At a composed checkpoint, pin exact artifact and route; run only the relevant comparator and preserve warnings/results per source identity.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB fixture downloaded or committed; use repository-owned samples or locally generated temporary controls.
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: Keep the established fast touched-target/focused-test cadence per slice. Full suites, sanitizers, broad fuzz, peer differentials, and native applications remain composed checkpoints.
